name: The Hellenizers who forsook the holy covenant
charge: Covenanting with the heathen; removing circumcision; profaning the Sabbath; sacrificing to idols
summary: In the days of Antiochus, wicked men went out of Israel persuading many to make a covenant with the heathen round about. They built a place of exercise at Jerusalem, made themselves uncircumcised, forsook the holy covenant, and were sold to do mischief. When the king's decree came, many Israelites consented to his religion.
offense: First Maccabees calls them sinners and wicked men; Second Maccabees traces the profaneness to Jason. Every mark of the covenant was surrendered by choice: circumcision, Sabbath, sacrifice, food, and the company of the nations.
judgment: Mattathias and his friends smote sinful men in their anger and wicked men in their wrath; the rest fled to the heathen for succour. Judas burnt up those that vexed his people, and the wicked shrunk for fear of him. After Antiochus, the ungodly out of Israel who sought Alcimus' priesthood found Judas had taken vengeance on their sort.

entries.commentary: At ninety and nine years old Abram was commanded to walk before the Most High and be perfect. There is no age excuse; Christ said nothing new in [Matthew 5:48](/bible/matthew/5#v48), for the command to be perfect was given thousands of years before. Perfect according to the scriptures means to walk in His statutes and keep His commandments; that is how Israel perfects itself.

When the Most High began dealing with Abram on a covenant level, his name was changed: Abram became Abraham, a father of many nations, and kings would come out of him. Father of many nations does not mean everybody is spiritually a child of Abraham. The same promise was passed down the seed line: Jacob's name was changed to Israel and told a nation and a company of nations and kings would come out of his loins. The blessing of all men and the covenant were made to rest upon the head of Jacob and divided among the twelve tribes. Kings come out of that seed, including Christ, the King of kings.
The covenant is with Abraham's seed after him, and seed is literal offspring, not a spiritual metaphor. The Most High promised to be a God to Abraham and to his seed after him.

Circumcision is the token of the covenant: every man child circumcised at eight days, and the uncircumcised soul cut off from his people. Abraham received circumcision as a seal of the righteousness of the faith he had yet being uncircumcised. He believed and obeyed first, and circumcision sealed it; likewise a brother can come into the truth, get built up in the faith, and then go through with the process. It still has to be done. A covenant is a contract with terms; the covenant was confirmed to Jacob for a law, and circumcision is one of the laws within the covenant.

Sarai's name was changed to Sarah, and she shall be a mother of nations; those are the same nations of the covenant, and she and Abraham had one child together, Isaac. Abraham fell on his face and laughed in his heart: shall a child be born to a hundred year old man, and Sarah bear at ninety? The Most High read his thought and named the child from it: Isaac means he will laugh.

Ishmael received a blessing: fruitful, multiplied exceedingly, twelve princes, a great nation. But the word to Abraham was kings shall come out of thee, and the covenant passes to Isaac: my covenant will I establish with Isaac. Not all who are of Abraham's seed are the children; in Isaac shall thy seed be called. Ishmael was born of the flesh, of Sarai's plan, with no word from God ordaining it; the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

The selfsame day Abraham circumcised every male of his house, himself at ninety and nine and Ishmael at thirteen. That is the righteous example: he received the commandment and performed it the same day.

The Lord called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, and filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship, to devise cunning works, to work in gold, in silver, in brass, in cutting of stones, and in carving of timber. With him the Lord gave Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, and put wisdom in the hearts of all that were wise hearted, that they might make all that he had commanded. The Most High still works the same way. Brothers and sisters come into the congregation who are carpenters, plumbers, electricians, builders, painters, cooks, and tech savvy, and he sets every one in the body as it pleases him; no one appoints himself over the camp or the kitchen. All the diverse gifts together build the work today the way the tabernacle was built then.

The wise hearted made all that was commanded: the tabernacle of the congregation, the ark of the testimony, the mercy seat that is thereupon, all the furniture of the tabernacle, the table and his furniture, the pure candlestick with all his furniture, the altar of incense, the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot. They made the cloths of service, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons to minister in the priest's office, the anointing oil, and the sweet incense for the holy place, according to all that the Lord commanded. That spirit of workmanship on Israel is why the tabernacle, and later the house Solomon built for the Lord, outshined anything the world had seen; and though strangers shall build up our walls in the kingdom, it will be Israel directing how the Lord wants it done.

Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep, for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you. Keeping the weekly sabbath and the feast days shows that Israel are his children and he is their God; the nations do not have this sabbath, and adopted Sunday worship is not the true sabbath given to the children of Israel. Every one that defileth the sabbath shall surely be put to death. The stoning was done away in Christ, but the judgment for breaking the sabbath still stands, and people still die on the sabbath day, Friday sundown to Saturday sundown; the Most High is justified, because it is his sign between him and his people. Six days may work be done, but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD. It is more than a day of rest and congregating; it is the sign of who Israel's God is, which is why saying the sabbath is done away takes away the very sign between Israel and God.

The children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant; it is a sign between the Most High and the children of Israel for ever, for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed. Christians use [Mark 2:27](/bible/mark/2#v27) to say the sabbath is done away, but that is not what Christ said. The sabbath was made for man, the children of Israel; man was not put on the earth for the sabbath, the sabbath was put on the earth for man, and the Son of man is Lord of the sabbath because Christ instituted it. He rested for our sakes, that we should rest after the same similitude.

When he had made an end of communing with Moses upon mount Sinai, he gave him two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God. God literally wrote the testimony with his finger, and we know that was Christ.

verses.text: In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us: for since we departed from them we have had much sorrow.
So this device pleased them well.
Then certain of the people were so forward herein, that they went to the king, who gave them licence to do after the ordinances of the heathen:
Whereupon they built a place of exercise at Jerusalem according to the customs of the heathen:
And made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant, and joined themselves to the heathen, and were sold to do mischief.
Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.
Then many of the people were gathered unto them, to wit every one that forsook the law; and so they committed evils in the land;
So they joined their forces, and smote sinful men in their anger, and wicked men in their wrath: but the rest fled to the heathen for succour.
Then Mattathias and his friends went round about, and pulled down the altars:
And what children soever they found within the coast of Israel uncircumcised, those they circumcised valiantly.
They pursued also after the proud men, and the work prospered in their hand.
So they recovered the law out of the hand of the Gentiles, and out of the hand of kings, neither suffered they the sinner to triumph.
For He pursued the wicked, and sought them out, and burnt up those that vexed his people.
Wherefore the wicked shrunk for fear of him, and all the workers of iniquity were troubled, because salvation prospered in his hand.
He grieved also many kings, and made Jacob glad with his acts, and his memorial is blessed for ever.
Moreover he went through the cities of Juda, destroying the ungodly out of them, and turning away wrath from Israel:
Now such was the height of Greek fashions, and increase of heathenish manners, through the exceeding profaneness of Jason, that ungodly wretch, and no high priest;

That the priests had no courage to serve any more at the altar, but despising the temple, and neglecting the sacrifices, hastened to be partakers of the unlawful allowance in the place of exercise, after the game of Discus called them forth;
Not setting by the honours of their fathers, but liking the glory of the Grecians best of all.
And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

lawsResolved.text: We are not to learn or follow the ways, customs or abominations of the heathen or of any ungodly nation.
Do not covenant with the heathen or their gods, or keep company with the heathen and idolaters.
Alliances and covenants (treaties) with pagan or ungodly nations are forbidden.
All male children born are to be circumcised on the eighth day after birth.
Anyone that has served or worshipped false or pagan gods shall be put to death.
Warning not to cause or tempt others to backslide.
